Morales) will be en route on the 12th and we’ve got a customer dinner that evening — looks like the team won’t be fully available for a 60-min block.

Kim / Steph —

Forwarding Elaine's note — NeoHealth has a roadtrip the week of our planned demo. They offered either April 18 full demo or a compressed 20–25 minute live session on April 12 with recording. Thoughts on which to push?

Considerations:
- If we compress: we need a razor-focused deck (25 min) that showcases latency, routing/fallback, and cost controls. I can handle the business flow, but would like Steph to own the Console live demo and Kim to have the cost/contract notes ready for post-demo.
- If we move to 18 April: higher chance of full exec attendance but risk losing momentum on the deal.

Proposed plan:
1) Offer compressed 25-minute live demo on 12 April at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET. Deliver a 6–8 slide executive deck (I'll attach demo-20min-deck.pdf) and record the session.
2) If they prefer 18 April, Jordan to reschedule and we add a 30-minute follow-up with product Q&A.

I can draft the compressed agenda by EOD and share the deck. If everyone agrees, I will send the updated invite and recording link.

Jordan
